home.home_subtitle: One card. One legend. Your move.

landing.hero_sub: More than 300 cards the moment you sign up, in the army you choose. Limited editions do the rest: no Expert deck looks like yours.
landing.hero_proof: Over 500 cards, free from your very first game
landing.f1_desc: Armies of Legends unites the strategy of iconic TCGs with mechanics built for today's champions.
landing.f2_title: As many cards as possible, right from the start.
landing.f2_desc: Get every classic card of the faction of your choice, free (over 300 cards). And unlock every faction (around 2,500 cards) for a fraction of the cost of a traditional TCG.
landing.f3_title: Every Expert deck, a singular work.
landing.f3_desc: Limited-edition cards make every Expert deck unique. A shared edition ensures only your strategy decides.
landing.f4_title: Mobile, at last worthy of the stakes.
landing.f4_desc: Tournaments rewarded with rare cards and cash prizes — a level of stakes once reserved for desktop TCGs.
landing.factions_title: Nine armies. The first one is yours.
landing.factions_sub: Pick your faction when you sign up: all of its classic cards, more than 300, are yours at no cost. The other factions can be added later for a fraction of what a classic TCG costs.
landing.showcase_sub: From the humblest creature to mythic heroes, every card matters.
landing.cta_sub: Join the summoners on the battlefield.
landing.footer: Armies of Legends — All rights reserved
